title: Taiwan's Lai in Marshall Islands as China fumes
description: MAJURO, Marshall Islands — Taiwanese leader Lai Ching-te arrived in the Marshall Islands on Tuesday, after visiting the United States on the first stop of a Pacific tour that has angered Chinese leaders.

title: Spare Parts For F-16s Included In US-Approved $385 Million Arms Sale To Taiwan
description: U.S. arms sales, including F-16 spare parts, to Taiwan unsurprisingly draw strong condemnation and countermeasures from China.

title: Why China’s bargaining chips would differ from Russia’s in a Taiwan conflict
description: In a Taiwan crisis, China’s economic strategies would hinge on tech and trade networks, setting it apart from Russia’s reliance on energy exports and alternative markets

title: Tensions Rise as China Prepares Potential War Games Near Taiwan
description: As tensions between China and Taiwan escalate, Taiwan's defence ministry is closely monitoring Chinese military activities, particularly the movements of an aircraft carrier. With Taiwan President Lai Ching-te's Pacific trip as a potential trigger, new war games could be launched by China, further stirring regional concerns.

title: Taiwan's Diplomatic Maneuver: A Strategic Pacific Tour
description: Taiwanese President William Lai's visit to Hawaii and Guam symbolizes a strategic move to counter China's Belt and Road Initiative. The journey aims to strengthen Taiwan's ties with Pacific islands and fortify regional defense, amidst US military presence and potential Chinese provocations.

title: China's Strategic Playbook: Learning from Russia to Counter Potential Sanctions in Taiwan Conflict
description: China has formed a task force to study Russia's evasion of Western sanctions post-Ukraine invasion. This group aims to prepare China for similar measures during a possible Taiwan crisis. Observing Russia's resilience, China seeks to safeguard its economy from potential sanctions, acknowledging its deeper integration into global markets.

title: Is Xi's system failing?
description: Xi Jinping faces a leadership crisis with PLA corruption scandals. It risks disrupting China’s military communications, including with India.

title: Labor senator Raff Ciccone says China and Russia should not be able to bully democracies
description: The head of federal parliament's intelligence committee has suggested Australia is bolstering its military capabilities in part to deter China from invading Taiwan.
